t: This is the railway bridge carrying trains over the Thames into Cannon Street station, one of the two London termini of the South Eastern Main Line, the other being Charing Cross. The station sits on Cannon Street in the City and serves commuters from south-east London and Kent. The bridge was designed by John Wolfe-Barry, the English civil engineer best known for Tower Bridge, which was built between 1886 and 1894. He was the youngest son of the architect Sir Charles Barry.
